It is further submitted that apart from the other sections in which the accused persons have been summoned,
they be also summoned under section 376 I.P.C. also.

5 . Per contra, learned A.G.A has supported the impugned order dated 27.4.2023 and has submitted that learned magistrate after making requisite enquiry by recording the statements of the witnesses under section 200 and 202 Cr.P.C. has rightly summoned O.P. No.2 under section 323, 504, 506

whereas Surendra, Avinash and Anil under section 354, 323, 504 and 506 I.P.C. He has further drawn attention of the Court to the provision contained under section 323 Cr.P.C. which provides that "if, in any inquiry into an offence or a trial before a magistrate, it appears to him at any stage of the proceedings before signing judgement that the case is one which ought to be tried by the court of Session, he shall, commit it to that court under the provisions hereinbefore contained" as such,

order passed by court below is just, proper and legal at this stage and can be modified further on the basis of evidence that may be adduced by the witnesses as such does not suffer from any illegality and liable to be upheld.

6. Having considered rival submissions of learned counsel for both the parties and taking into consideration the fact that at this stage only on the basis of prima facie satisfaction, the magistrate has summoned Opposite parties no. 2, 3, 5, 6 under the relevant section However, if during course of further inquiry and trial and the evidence adduced, the court of magistrate comes to conclusion that other offences triable by court of Session are also disclosed against the accused persons then he may commit the case to the court of Session in view of the provisions contained in section 323 Cr.P.C.

At this stage, the impugned order passed by the court below can not be said to be illegal or bad in law and therefore can not be set-aside in exercise of power under section 482 Cr.P.C.
7.
The present application filed under section 482 Cr.P.C. is devoid of merit and is accordingly dismissed.
